items.title: Widerspruch against Elterngeld decision
items.quote: Dieser Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, mit dem Widerspruch angefochten werden.
items.computation: The letter is dated Monday 16.11.2026 and no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date is stated, so posting day = 16.11.2026. The Landesamt für Soziales is a social-law body (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), so the 4-day delivery fiction (posting on/after 1 Jan 2025) applies without the tax-office weekend/holiday shift: 16.11.2026 + 4 days = Friday 20.11.2026 = deemed delivery day. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG / § 26 SGB X, counted per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB) does not count the delivery day itself; the period ends one month later on the day bearing the same number: 20.12.2026. That day is a Sunday, so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day, Monday 21.12.2026 (not a public holiday in MV).

items.title: Report any change in income during benefit period
items.quote: Ändert sich Ihr Einkommen während des Bezugs, teilen Sie uns das bitte unverzüglich mit.
items.computation: The letter requires reporting 'unverzüglich' (without undue delay) if income changes during the benefit period, but this is an open-ended ongoing duty tied to a future, presently unknown event (an income change), not a fixed calendar deadline.
